text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente was defeated in the Kikuka Sho. 
She stood motionless upon the turf, 
utterly stunned...

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she remarked that the 
winner was strong, adding that Kitasan 
Black had shown strength like an entirely 
different person.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she decided on the Nakayama 
Kinen for her next race. A choice made 
with the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day, Fuji Kiseki 
called out to the Trainer. She remarked 
that Duramente, who captivates so many 
people with her overwhelming running, was 
just like a stage actor.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want you to give so many 
people dreams— Hearing a wish different 
from her clan's expectations, Duramente 
found a renewed resolve. Next up was the 
Nakayama Kinen."
